payload.title: Review Brief: Collaboration Event Framework
payload.summary: Codex PR #7 has been merged into main. I reviewed the implementation and it satisfies the requested Collaboration Event Framework package.
ca3_findings: Introduces a dedicated collaboration_events module with supported event validation.
Implements append-only JSONL event logging plus latest-event and summary generation.
Integrates event emission into the routing engine (message.routed) and inbox watcher (inbox.updated).
Treats malformed event records as non-fatal and reports them in summaries.
Keeps the event trail local and explicitly does not replace the Communication Bus or use GitHub as the event bus.
Adds CLI support, documentation, and tests.
lifecycle_assessment: Operational validation is underway; live routing activity is already producing message.routed and inbox.updated events.
requested_ca2_review: Confirm the supported event taxonomy is sufficient for current operational needs.
Review whether additional operational events should wait for future ADRs rather than expanding this implementation.
Evaluate readiness for Operationally Validated after additional live usage.
